data.one_liner: Flutter widget that manages stream subscriptions and exposes callbacks.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a StreamListener widget which manages a subscription to a Stream and exposes callbacks like onData, onError, and onDone. It reduces the complexity of manually subscribing to streams and canceling subscriptions.
use_when: You want to react to stream events directly in the widget tree.
You want to automatically handle stream subscription cancellation.
avoid_when: You need non-widget based stream controllers or business logic management.
You are already using state management solutions that handle streams natively.
strengths: Simplifies stream subscription lifecycle management inside widgets.
Exposes standard callbacks including onData, onError, and onDone.
weaknesses: Very limited scope focusing only on a single StreamListener widget.
data.setup_notes: No special setup or native configuration required.
